items.title: Fever stay (too) hot in Toronto, win fifth straight behind Mitchell and Clark
items.body_excerpt: The Indiana Fever’s first trip to Toronto in familiar fashion with another win. It was their fifth in a row as they beat the Tempo 101-85 in front of a sellout crowd of 19,300 at Scotiabank Arena. The Fever never trailed and built a lead as large as 17, getting an immediate lift…
